title: Kevin Marshall and Danny Wood split the sled push and took a Hyrox world title home to Cornwall

posts.facebook:
Two Cornishmen with day jobs trained on Saturday mornings in Lifton and came home Hyrox world champions.

How Kevin Marshall and Danny Wood, men with jobs and families, trained in Lifton and won a Hyrox world title as a pair, what the race involves, why its mix of running and strength suits the weekly guidelines, and how to start, whether you have never pushed a sled or are ready to race.

A hard race shared with the right partner, and trained for alongside beginners, is within reach of people with full lives.
